visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three orange and white Corgis sit side-by-side in a vast snowy mountain landscape. Behind them, several dark-furred yaks graze in the snow against a backdrop of jagged, snow-capped peaks under a bright sun. (2) The scene shifts as the three Corgis begin running energetically toward the camera across the snowy terrain, their tongues lolling out in joyful expressions. (3) The environment changes rapidly to a lush green forest; the Corgis continue their synchronized run through a dirt path surrounded by tall trees and dappled sunlight. (4) As they continue running, the background fills with a group of wild boars trailing behind them in a dense, sun-lit wooded area. (5) The Corgis come to a sudden halt, sitting together and looking directly at the camera while wild boars wander in the blurred background. (6) Three grey metal buckets suddenly descend from above and land precisely over the heads of the three Corgis, obscuring their faces. (7) In a seamless visual transition, the Corgis transformed into three standing blue gas canisters, which remain stationary in the forest setting. (8) A massive orange and white explosion erupts directly behind the gas canisters, sending smoke upward as the wild boars scatter. (9) Transparent orange logos with the text '芒果燃气' appear on the front of each canister, and a question mark icon appears over a wild boar's head.
